description: This file defines type identification and metadata management for the Caffe2 framework within PyTorch, including classes like TypeIdentifier and TypeMeta, macros for registering types, and mechanisms for handling type-specific functions and data.

classes.name: TypeIdentifier
classes.description: Represents a unique runtime identifier for C++ types, used for type registration and comparison.

classes.name: TypeMetaData
classes.description: Holds metadata about a type, including size, constructor, destructor, and name.

classes.name: TypeMeta
classes.description: Provides runtime type information, including size, name, and functions for constructing, copying, and destroying objects of the type.

methods.name: TypeIdentifier::Get<T>()
methods.description: Returns a unique TypeIdentifier for type T.

methods.name: TypeMeta::Make<T>()
methods.description: Creates a TypeMeta object for type T.

methods.name: TypeMeta::fromScalarType(scalar_type)
methods.description: Converts a ScalarType enum to a TypeMeta.

methods.name: TypeMeta::toScalarType()
methods.description: Converts a TypeMeta to a ScalarType enum.
